## Operator backup

The operator maintains an external backup of the Grace-Mar fork snapshot. Record the backup location in your private ops notes when executing the deprecation pass (not committed here unless you choose to).

## Revive

Say **`fork revive`** or use coffee **`A gate`** when you intentionally reopen gate/merge work. Merge only via `scripts/process_approved_candidates.py --apply` after approval.
